title: Brain Tumor
excerpt: While I was recovering, I went to my doctor for a regular check—up.
content:
While I was recovering, I went to my doctor for a regular check—up. Sadly he informed me that I also had hypertension, high—cholesterol and an arthritic disc in my back, which didn’t surprise me because I suffered from chronic pain in my neck, arms and legs. I thought that things couldn’t get any worse when in March 2003, right after St. Patrick’s Day I had a massive grand-mal seizure. When I awoke, I told my wife not to be upset but something very serious had just happened. I went to the doctor who sent me immediately for a CAT scan. He told me that I had a lesion—a large tumor in the area of my brain that controls thought and suggested an MRI to get a better view. The most disturbing news—the tumor was inoperable. It had been growing with my brain for so long that it was intricately woven into my brain tissue.

He wanted to consult with my family explaining that if this had happened to his wife he would send her to a doctor at Columbia Hospital. He also said that eventually the mass would grow; and, when it did they would attempt to remove 70% of it. If I survived the surgery they would give me radiation and chemotherapy In the meantime, he prescribed Dilanten® for my seizures. At this point, I had no energy and was unable to work or play with my children and was sleeping 18 to 20 hours a day One day a family friend stopped by and told us how he and his mother had been helped by Hippocrates. After hearing of this, my parents sent me for the Life Change Program. It was difficult at first; I could barely sit up or concentrate. But, I persevered and learned what the Institute had to offer. I began an incredible transformation, starting at Hippocrates and continuing when I arrived home to my family Now all of my life-altering disorders, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, pain and even the activity in my tumor have either disappeared or diminished significantly According to my latest MRI, the tumor has two dead spots in the middle and the swelling is gone! I am the healthiest I have ever been in my life and have Hippocrates Wellness to thank!
